title: Telemedical Risk Assessment and Preoperative Evaluation (TAPE)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the feasibility, patient satisfaction and time saving of a telemedical risk assessment and preoperative evaluation for anesthesia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ≥18 years
* estimated ASA I/II classification based on the American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) classification
* elective surgery
* surgery at least 14 days in the future
* patient access to a Windows-10-based personal computer with webcam

Exclusion Criteria:

* language or cognitive barriers (e.g. dementia, laryngectomy...)
* high risk surgeries with need of postoperative ICU stay
* acute infection with required auscultation
condition: Patients Undergoing Elective Surgery With Anesthesia
